The delay is unacceptable, especially given the numerous issues I faced during my stay and move-out process. The hostel staff unreasonably withheld my exit until I provided an electricity bill, which was delayed due to server problems beyond my control, causing me to miss my flight. Despite this inconvenience, I chose not to hold YourSpace accountable for that loss.
During my stay, maintenance was poor, rooms were inadequately cleaned, and staff often ignored requests for help. One staff member in particular was rude and disrespectful. On top of all this, I found a rat in the dining area, which raises serious concerns about hygiene and safety.

Overall, it’s overpriced, unhygienic, and poorly managed. All talk, no delivery.
